claims.statement: On 23 September 2026 the UN Security Council addressed risks from advanced AI; OpenAI and Anthropic were part of the briefing.
The EU AI Act requires, for applicable high-risk AI systems, measures including continuous risk management and effective human oversight.
Freedom of the press is protected in Germany by Article 5 of the Basic Law.
QIK-VRT Mesh Audit run 29753095894 reports PASS for its explicitly defined audit scope.

QIK-VRT includes a provider-neutral external-AI auditor that automatically evaluates evidence-bound execution traces with PASS/BLOCK; its conformance workflow accepts the positive vector and blocks silent omission of required follow-up and unauthorized effects.
Strong capital, market and geopolitical competitive pressure can shorten safety and maturity cycles; this is a systems analysis, not a character judgment about a nation.
The phrase 'functionally bankrupt' is an author's warning metaphor for loss of rule-of-law function, not a legal insolvency or status finding.
QIK-VRT Formalization v2.0 documents complete formal coverage of its stated manuscript scope with explicit boundaries.
QIK-VRT physics models are formalized research candidates; mathematical model verification is not presented as empirical confirmation of nature.
The evidence-sufficiency decision maxim is a normative interpretation, not empirical or legal proof.
Spiritual claims are labeled as religious-philosophical interpretation and are not presented as mathematical or physical proof.

An absolute world-first claim such as 'the first interactive news portal in human history' is not presented as established. Earlier standards for machine-readable journalistic self-assessment and transparency exist.
The external-AI audit is fully automatic for a supplied evidence-bound audit trace; it does not claim privileged access to hidden provider state.
German, English, French, Russian, Persian and Chinese share the same article ID, version, segment IDs, claim IDs, source set and correction lineage; structural equivalence is checked automatically.
